The actor is the contract 0x000000000035b5e5ad9019092c665357240f594e. It holds the SFI after the front leg and gives all of it up in the back leg, so no SFI residual remains.

Net WETH = 6.078279 − 5.966286 = 0.111993.

Gas for the two legs = 0.004763 + 0.078847 = 0.083610 ETH.

Net after gas = 0.111993 − 0.083610 = 0.028383, which is positive.

I take the gas from the fee figures shown. The back-leg fee checks out: 58509 × 1347.6 gwei = 0.078847 ETH. The front-leg fee also checks out: 69012 × 69 gwei = 0.004762 ETH.

The sender of both legs is 0x3856…, but the contract is the one holding the position, so I name the contract as the actor. The back leg paid a very high gas price, probably a priority bid to land right after the victim, yet the net is still positive.
